objective: Combine the observed completion counts, compare with the group mean, and explain the limits of this comparison.

inputs.text: In this fictional reading program, Juniper circle enrolled thirty-two readers; sixteen readers submitted a reading log by Sunday.
Hawthorn circle enrolled fifty readers; thirty readers submitted a reading log by Sunday.
Both circles count completion as submitting a reading log by Sunday of the reporting week. Each reader is enrolled in only one circle; the circles have no members in common.
Prior reading experience and time available were not measured, so the counts cannot identify the cause of the difference.

objective: 计算合并检查通过率和组等权平均，并区分数量结论与因果解释。

inputs.text: 虚构质检报告中，东堤批次共有十五件样品，其中九件通过周三检查。
西岭批次共有四十件样品，其中二十件通过周三检查。
两个批次均按相同标准在同一周三完成检查。每件样品只属于一个批次，两个批次没有重复样品。
原料状况和存放时间没有记录，不能据此解释两个批次通过率差异的原因。

objective: Find the success rate for unique people from both groups if the supplied evidence permits pooling.

inputs.text: In a fictional skills report, Birch group contains twenty learners; eight learners passed the assessment.
Rowan group contains thirty learners; eighteen learners passed the assessment.
Both groups use the same assessment and Friday deadline. Whether the groups share learners is unknown.
Previous experience and practice time are absent, so the report does not establish a cause for differing pass rates.

objective: 求两组学员合并达标率和等权平均；缺少数据时说明无法完成的计算。

inputs.text: 虚构记录中，晴川组共有二十四名学员，其中六名通过考核。
明溪组有十六名学员通过考核，参加考核的学员总数未知。
两组使用同一考核标准和同一周五截止时间。每名学员只属于一个组，两组没有重复学员。
练习时长和入组前水平没有记录，所以无法从这些数量解释组间差异的原因。
